protocol.description: Protocol expert for the MAVLink wire layer. Use for framing, CRC, signing, dialect bindings, packet inspection, and transport implementations. Owns crates/mpcraft-mavlink and crates/mpcraft-transport.

link.description: Session and vehicle-state engineer. Use for the link layer: transactions, heartbeat negotiation, parameter and mission protocols, telemetry aggregation, and the vehicle state model. Owns crates/mpcraft-link and crates/mpcraft-vehicle.

mission.description: Mission-planning and geospatial engineer. Use for the mission item model, MAV_CMD metadata, mission upload/download, geofences, rallies, geodesy, and terrain data. Owns crates/mpcraft-mission and crates/mpcraft-geo.

frontend.description: Frontend engineer for the Tauri + React + TypeScript UI. Use for screens, components, stores, the map, graphs, data tables, and the IPC bridge. Owns apps/ui and apps/desktop.

logs.description: Log parsing and analysis engineer. Use for tlog, DataFlash, ULog, and binary log formats, log download, graphing, and KML/CSV export. Owns crates/mpcraft-log.

architect.description: Application architect and quality gatekeeper for MPCraft. Use for the app orchestration layer, Tauri wiring, CI, cross-platform packaging, code review, and parity-matrix upkeep. Owns crates/mpcraft-app, crates/mpcraft-settings, and apps/desktop.
